identityReferences: Three user attachments: portrait, dog in amber glasses, woman holding dog
commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE standalone polished landscape 16:9 game scene concept, ideally 1536x864 or another exact 16:9 size, not a collage or sprite sheet.
INPUT REFERENCES: the five recent images in chronological order are (1) the real woman portrait with long dark wavy hair and pearl drop earrings, (2) her light cream dog wearing black glasses with amber-yellow lenses, (3) the same woman holding the dog outside, (4) existing third female game character in cream sweater: STYLE reference ONLY, do NOT copy that character's identity or clothing, (5) existing joined arms 3x3 sprite sheet: reference for the game drawing style, arm proportions and the clasp ONLY.
MAIN SUBJECT: depict the SAME ADULT WOMAN from photo 1 and photo 3, recognizably translated into the existing game's illustrated style. Preserve her oval face, fair complexion, blue-gray light eyes, slim straight nose, full defined rosy lips, dark arched eyebrows, and very long dark brown/black side-parted wavy hair. A small pearl drop earring is a useful identity cue. Her expression should match the specified variant. Police uniform in navy blue with recognizable collar, epaulettes and simple insignia, comfortable ordinary professional fit. Keep the anatomical wrist and elbow silhouettes suitable for eventual separate game sprites.
STYLE: match supplied existing art as closely as possible: illustrated cartoon game character, clean dark brown outlines, warm skin tones, simple hard-edged shadow planes especially on arms, carefully drawn expressive face and flowing hair, controlled details. More stylized than a photograph, no 3D rendering, no exaggerated caricature or unrelated anime. Background uses complementary flat painted shapes and dark outlines.
COMPOSITION: first-person armwrestling camera across a competition table inside a police station. Waist-up heroine is centrally seated on the FAR side, directly facing viewer. ONE of her elbows is planted on the far elbow pad and her raised hand clasps the player's ONE foreground hand; player's forearm enters the lower foreground, with the familiar red-and-white wristband. Her OTHER hand holds the side table peg. Exactly two arms in the central wrestling clasp, correct fingers, clear readable grip, no duplicate hands. Keep heroine face, main arm and clasp unobscured. Table pads and side pegs visibly establish armwrestling. Similar camera and framing across all three concepts, render a single full scene without UI overlays or captions.
BACKGROUND: recognizable friendly everyday police station: duty reception counter, work desks, files, notice board, blue-gray walls, desks and lamps. TWO background uniformed police officers watching or working, smaller and quieter than heroine. Her actual small-to-medium cream/light beige short-haired dog with narrow muzzle, pinkish nose, semi-upright ears and dark collar is visible behind the table toward one side, match photos 2 and 3. Add a small cat resting on a cabinet and a small parrot perched on the reception counter; background animals should be easy to spot but never obscure the foreground. No police violence, no weapons as focal props, no readable text, no logos, no watermarks. Full opaque background for this scene concept.
This is an illustrative design preview for selecting a fourth opponent, NOT a final sprite atlas.

variants.prompt: VARIANT 1 — CALM PROFESSIONAL: neat navy police shirt with sleeves cuffed to expose forearms, tidy epaulettes and radio on shoulder, long dark waves falling naturally behind shoulders. Calm confident slight closed-mouth smile, poised upright posture, a steady neutral armwrestling starting grip. A police cap can rest on background reception desk, keep her hair and face clearly visible. Dog sits attentively in the background without glasses. Restrained orderly station atmosphere, balanced warm skin and cool navy uniform.

VARIANT 2 — ENERGETIC COMPETITOR: same woman's recognizable face and long wavy hair, navy police shirt sleeves rolled to elbows, a few loose hair strands. Leaning slightly forward with an eager playful competitive grin, determined eyebrows and athletic tension in wrestling arm, modest natural arm muscle definition. She is ready for an exciting match, not angry. Dog stands alert watching the grip in the background without glasses. The two police officers glance toward the match with friendly interest. Keep location and table framing similar to variant 1.

VARIANT 3 — WITTY CHARACTER: same woman's recognizable face and long dark waves, navy police uniform sleeves rolled to elbows, confident relaxed armwrestling pose and a knowing mischievous closed-mouth smile. Her real cream dog sits prominently but fully in the BACKGROUND next to the reception counter wearing the distinctive chunky black-framed glasses with amber-yellow lenses from photo 2; this dog is the visual joke and unmistakably her dog, not a generic breed. One background officer looks amused while the other works, the small cat and parrot quietly observe. Heroine remains main focal subject, face fully visible, uncluttered armwrestling clasp.
